correctness.rationale: A complete independent extendibility census and downward-closure enumeration agree on 30,504 faces from 36 perfect matchings. The coordinate-toggle discrete-Morse matching pairs 15,231 face pairs, with complete DAG acyclicity over 30,503 nonempty faces and 163,650 incidences; the critical cells are one 0-cell, ten 2-cells and thirty 3-cells. Signed gradient-path recursion gives the explicit 10×30 integer attaching matrix: rank nine mod 2, rank ten mod 3 and a specified 10×10 determinant-two minor. Its exact Smith invariants are nine ones and one two. The simply-connected reduced 2-skeleton is ten S² cells and the π₂→H₂ Hurewicz isomorphism identifies all 3-cell attaching maps with the matrix; cellular Smith operations yield M(Z/2,2) ∨ ∨²⁰S³. Original-complex independent mod-two boundary ranks support but do not replace the integral argument. The packaged code and boundary certificate replay exactly.

value.rationale: The dodecahedron is a canonical symmetric cubic Platonic graph and its complex of perfect-matching-extendible partial matchings is a natural topological invariant. The result determines its entire integral homotopy type, exhibiting a genuinely nontrivial 2-torsion Moore-space summand which contrasts with published torsion-free wedge/contractible results for specified perfect-matching-complex families. It is a mathematically motivated explicit torsion test case rather than a routine minor numerical improvement, without claiming a general family theorem.
